name: Offside
verdict: Offside is the trade name of Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment Co, a sportswear company. Nothing found.
note: Saudi sportswear brand; kit supplier to Al-Hazem for 2026/27 (club announcement, 2026-07-04) and to other Saudi clubs including Al-Shabab, Al-Fateh and Al-Taawoun (offsideksa.com). Trade name of Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment Co (al-kas.com, 2025-12-03). No state body or fund found in the chain, and no human-rights finding against the company found (searched 2026-10-03).
